summary: Minimal, correct one-line fix that propagates AnnotationBbox's gid to its patch before drawing, mirroring the pattern used elsewhere in the file for other offsetbox artists. No regression or compatibility concerns.

issues.description: Only patch gid is set explicitly here; other sub-elements (e.g., arrow_patch, offsetbox) may already have their own gid handling but this PR doesn't address whether nested artists also need explicit propagation, though this matches the scope of the linked issue.
